== Editing ==
This shared table is the '''Errata''' section on the English original and [[Admiral Motti (Errata)]] articles. Columns are Original and Decipher Errata only. Glossary 2.0. Appendix A repeats that Glossary text and is not a separate PC Errata column. The 2017 overlay slip and later D-E1 reconstruction are the same errata. Do not add Unlimited, Japanese, foil, or (V) columns. {{tl|Errata hl}} only the words or values that changed. See [[SWCCG Wiki:Style guide#Errata comparison table]].
